success.narration: You cross those six feet between two waves of boots. The drainage arch takes you below the shouting, through cold brick, and out beyond the square. Behind you, the costume keeps snapping above the pump; ahead, the channel widens into a flooded dead-end hall where pale figures are moving against the current.

payload.method: runoff crawl beneath the crowd’s sightline
payload.objectiveRef: escape the mob surge through the drainage arch

nearMiss.narration: A heel catches your shoulder, but its owner thinks they stepped on refuse. You bite down on the cry and slide through the arch with one fresh bruise. The costume still snaps above the pump; ahead, the channel widens into a flooded dead-end hall where pale figures move against the current.

payload.method: bruising runoff crawl under the crowd
payload.objectiveRef: escape the mob surge through the drainage arch

fail.narration: A boot pins your coat before the arch. You wrench free, leaving cloth and skin against the cobbles, but the shout follows you back to the cart-rut mouth. You are still outside the drain, hurt and fully marked as the person who planted the flag; the roof stair remains open.
